news_items.headline: ROK Stock Surges 5.4% on May 6, 2026 After Strong Earnings Beat
news_items.summary: ROK closed at $459.35 (+5.37%) on May 6, 2026 after fiscal Q2 2026 earnings beat. Volume hit 1.18M shares, well above average. Stock now near 52-week high of $463.49 with $51.7B market cap.

news_items.headline: Why Rockwell Automation (ROK) Is Up 8.6% After Raising 2026 Guidance On Strong Q2 Results
news_items.summary: Q2 FY2026 adjusted EPS $3.30 vs $2.92 consensus; revenue $2.24B vs ~$2.18B expected. Management raised FY2026 outlook to ~$8.9B revenue with higher EPS guidance, citing strong demand from data centers, semiconductors, and warehouse automation.

news_items.summary: TipRanks reports ROK posted top- and bottom-line beats with double-digit growth in warehouse automation, data centers, and semiconductors driving the revised full-year outlook.

news_items.headline: Rockwell Automation (ROK) Sees Analyst Rating Update from Baird
news_items.summary: Baird issued a post-earnings analyst rating update on ROK. Sentiment direction not specified in the result snippet.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Post-earnings (May 6-7, 2026) saw multiple firms downgrade to Hold and trim price targets — Wall Street Zen, Jefferies, Wells Fargo, and Barclays — suggesting valuation concerns now that ROK trades near its 52-week high ($463.49) above the $420.88 average PT. Baird also issued an update. Aggregate consensus remains 19 buys / 2 holds / 0 sells (Moderate Buy).

earnings_context.notes: Most recent print (fiscal Q2 2026, reported ~May 6) beat on both lines: adj EPS $3.30 vs $2.92 consensus, revenue $2.24B vs $2.18B. Management raised FY2026 guidance to ~$8.9B revenue with higher EPS. Demand strength cited in data centers, semiconductors, energy, and warehouse automation. Next catalyst is Q3 FY2026 print on Aug 5, 2026 — well outside the 3-day blackout window.
